## Technical analysis (Wednesday July 1, 2026 — Q3 Day 1 partial, as of 11:03 UTC)

**BTC July 1 Crypto.com MCP partial candle (11:03 UTC):** O$58,627.85 / H$59,467.99 / L$57,802.93 / C$58,637.94. Volume: 1,194 BTC ($70.0M) — partial, 11 of 24 hours elapsed.

**Trend: Bearish.** Eleven consecutive UTC sessions below $62,000. Lower-high lower-low pattern: June 29 high $60,784 → June 30 high $60,282 → July 1 partial high $59,468 (new sequence low for the high). The June 29 dead-cat bounce ($60,253) was the high-water mark of the distribution; subsequent closes ($58,621 June 30, $58,638 July 1 partial) confirm the bearish continuation.

**★ CRITICAL: $58,100 structural support breached intraday.** The $58,100 level held exactly on June 25 (low $58,100.00) and was $86 above on June 30 low ($58,186). Today's low of $57,802 is $298 below the support. BTC has recovered to $58,638 but the breach signals the support is weakening. A UTC midnight close below $58,100 would confirm structural failure and activate $57,500 as the next target.

**Volume: Light so far.** 1,194 BTC ($70.0M) in 11 hours. Extrapolated: ~2,600 BTC for the full session — below June 30 (3,776 BTC) and June 29 (3,433 BTC). Lighter volume on a support breach could indicate selling exhaustion OR simply reflects early-session holiday-gap positioning before NFP.

**★ Strongest resistance: $62,000.** Eleven consecutive UTC closes locked below. The re-entry gate requires TWO consecutive closes above — at $58,647, the gate is $3,353 (+5.72%) away. Institutional IBIT sellers are positioned to sell into any $62,000 approach.

**★ Strongest support: $57,500.** Activates on confirmed close below $58,100. The $57,500 level is the next major support from April 2026 accumulation. A confirmed breach would represent a new multi-month low and risk stop-loss cascade.

**Decision: Flat/cash.** No re-entry before NFP July 2 + two consecutive UTC closes above $62,000 + IBIT inflow resumption. Watch the July 1 UTC midnight close closely: above $58,100 = support reclaim possibility; below = framework accelerates bearish.
